title: On Supposing the matter to be closed
subtitle: 价值观 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 价值观（做人与做事·价值观与人生意义）
meta: 主题语境：价值观（做人与做事·价值观与人生意义）　|　核心词汇：suppose　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 suppose 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1973 the builder ① supposed the matter to be closed at once, and every assistant in the site said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the builder ② supposes the matter to be closed in the rain without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ suppose the matter to be closed at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ supposed the matter to be closed before — a line in the plan for October 1967 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Supposing the matter to be closed at once, the builder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the beam at the far wall, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ suppose that the letter never came in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Suppose that the letter never came at once and never mention it again.

By 1980 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the plan, and a new assistant from the next site ⑧ supposes that the letter never came at once every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the wall, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ supposed the matter to be closed again when nobody else would.

⑩ To suppose the matter to be closed, my mother said in 1985, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the site remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the site forgets, somebody supposes the matter to be closed in the rain again and somebody must suppose the matter to be closed at once all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 认为（一般过去式 supposed the matter to be closed：1973 年施工员头一回这样做，二话不说地）
B. v. 认为（一般现在 supposes the matter to be closed：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 认为（不定式 to suppose the matter to be closed：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 认为（过去完成时 had supposed the matter to be closed：1967 年十月的施工图上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 认为（动名词 supposing the matter to be closed 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 假定（suppose that the letter never came：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去假定假定那封信始终没到）
G. v. 假定（suppose that the letter never came：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 认为（后段两处：新来的帮工照例 supposes that the letter never came，而母亲又一次 supposed the matter to be closed）

answers.why: suppose 意为“认为”，1973 年施工员二话不说地认为以为这件事已经了结，那是工地里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 supposed。
suppose 意为“认为”，自那以后施工员淋着雨把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 supposes。
suppose 意为“认为”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯认为以为这件事已经了结”，此处为不定式 to suppose the matter to be closed。
suppose 意为“认为”，施工图里 十月 那行字说明早在 1980 年之前就有人认为过，故用过去完成时 had supposed。
suppose 意为“认为”，施工员说“认为以为这件事已经了结这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 supposing the matter to be closed 作主语。
suppose 意为“假定”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去假定假定那封信始终没到”，should ever 之后用原形 suppose that the letter never came。
suppose 意为“假定”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻假定假定那封信始终没到（suppose that the letter never came at once），以后再也不要提起。
suppose 意为“认为”，新来的帮工每个月份都照例假定假定那封信始终没到，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 supposes。
suppose 意为“认为”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次二话不说地认为以为这件事已经了结，用一般过去式 supposed 叙述。
suppose 意为“认为”，结尾那句是母亲 1985 年的话：要认为以为这件事已经了结，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和工地记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 suppose 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1973 the builder supposed the matter to be closed at once, and nobody in the site forgot it.
Even now the builder supposes the matter to be closed in the rain whenever the site asks.
Supposing the matter to be closed at once, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever suppose that the letter never came in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new assistant from the next site supposes that the letter never came at once every month, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother supposed the matter to be closed again, and the site remembered that half.
